title: Loan flat charge 0.5 (USD, 0 dp) rounds to zero and is refused (HTTP 403)
scenario: Attempt to add a flat loan charge of 0.50 (digitsAfterDecimal=0): fraction 0.5 is <= 0.5 so it rounds DOWN to zero, which the API must refuse without persisting the charge.
grade: Refuse when the rounded charge amount is zero; no charge row may be persisted.
